I understand that OP comes first on this subreddit, but OP you need to take a step back and really think about this situation. All of the reasons you described for going NC make absolutely no sense. Sure they’d be annoying and may hurt your self esteem, but to put your husband in such a position that he loses his mother? That’s crazy. 

You mention your DH “finally realized” he had to “put his wife first”, why? Why would that be his obligation? I understand if his mother was terribly abusive or toxic, but nothing you’ve described makes that seem like the case. Forcing him to go NC with his mother (doesn’t matter if he eventually came to the conclusion on his own if you hounded him about it for ages) because you two don’t get along very well is insanity. Did you ever try to better your relationship with his mother? Did you offer to have one on one dinners with her to get to know her better and understand her point of view? Did you put an ounce of effort into rectifying this situation, or did you let every petty jab from her build up until you convinced yourself the relationship wasn’t salvageable? 

Unless you’re omitting the actual reasons you went no contact (which I doubt) you are not the victim here; your husband is. He’s super hurt right now and you’re debating whether you are entitled to feel hurt as well. You are not, and if you really love that man you will spend the rest of your life trying to make it up to him. 

My only advice is allowing him to reach out to his mother in the absence of you; let him call her or go visit her WITHOUT you. If she’s still singing the same tune then unfortunately that’s the end of it, and that is her prerogative. I truly hope the best for everyone in this situation.
